about_the_game:
Trouble has fallen upon King Joy and The Kingdom of Vrila. The Queen has gone missing and Shadows consume the land! A mysterious Dark Portal to the now corrupted Nature Realm has appeared in The Royal Garden.

Venture into The Nature Realm which has now been consumed by dark memories and unravel the mystery behind the consuming Shadows and The Queens disappearance.

short_description: Swing, dash, slide and slice your way through the Corrupted Nature Realm. Blast, hack and slash your opponents or bounce off their heads! Power up Special Agent Lawt and rid the land of consuming shadows in this retro inspired 2D Action Platformer RPG.
